This notice applies to artwork/livery.xcf, artwork/decals.svg, artwork/logo.svg,
car1-stock1.rgb and logo.rgb. Keep the source artwork and this attribution
when distributing your modified example, and identify your changes.

The livery derives from the stock-car layered artwork in the TORCS source tree:
data/cars/models/car1-stock1/car1-stock1.xcf (see its adjacent readme.txt).
Upstream source:
https://sourceforge.net/p/torcs/code/ci/HEAD/tree/torcs/torcs/data/cars/models/car1-stock1/

Changes: red base paint, cream side panels, dark trim, replacement number-8
badges and tutorial lettering; preserved body details, windows and UV guides.
The layered XCF and editable decal SVG are the sources for this adaptation.
The pit logo is new artwork, supplied as an editable SVG. No external image
files are needed by either SVG. The rendered .rgb files are SGI images, not
renamed PNG files.

C++ source, build/configuration files and maintenance scripts retain their
separate GPL-2.0-or-later licensing. Tutorial text and teaching diagrams use
GNU FDL 1.2-or-later. This artwork notice does not relicense those files.
